## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and results, including anything not tested and why.

## Research evidence (if applicable)

Give data provenance, reproduction commands, model/device/configuration,
baseline and limitations. Distinguish new runs from re-analysis.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or I explained why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal/patient data, weights or private artifacts are included.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute included code and data.
